versions.content: For Pure Local Time Bases all bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus shall be set to 0, except for bit GLOBAL_TIME_BASE . GLOBAL_TIME_BASE shall be set to 1, by a valid invocation of StbM_S etGlobalTime() or StbM_UpdateGlobalTime() and only set to 0 by StbM_Init() .

For Pure Local Time Bases all bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus shall be set to 0, except for bit GLOBAL_TIME_BASE . GLOBAL_TIME_BASE shall be set to 1, by a valid invocation of StbM_S etGlobalTime() or StbM_UpdateGlobalTime() and only set to 0 by StbM_Init() .

For Pure Local Time Bases all bits of the Time Base status time BaseStatus shall be set to 0, except for bit GLOBAL_TIME_BASE . GLOBAL_TIME_BASE shall be set to 1, by a valid invocation of StbM_SetGlobalTime or StbM_UpdateGlobalTime and only set to 0 by StbM_Init .

For Pure Local Time Bases the StbM shall • allow to change – the GLOBAL_TIME_BASE bit (according to [SWS_StbM_00571] and [SWS_StbM_00572]) – and the RATE_CORRECTED bit (according to [SWS_StbM_00411], [SWS_StbM_00535]) • and keep all other bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus at their initial state 0.

For Pure Local Time Bases the StbM shall • allow to change – the GLOBAL_TIME_BASE bit (according to [SWS_StbM_00571] and [SWS_StbM_00572]) – and the RATE_CORRECTED bit (according to [SWS_StbM_00570], [SWS_StbM_00535]) • and keep all other bits of the Time Base status timeBaseStatus at their initial state 0.
